def extract_text(content):
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        parts = []
        for item in content:
            if isinstance(item, str):
                parts.append(item)
            elif isinstance(item, dict):
                if item.get(&#34;type&#34;) == &#34;text&#34;:
                    parts.append(item.get(&#34;text&#34;, &#34;&#34;))
                elif &#34;text&#34; in item:
                    parts.append(str(item[&#34;text&#34;]))
        return &#34;\n&#34;.join(parts)
    if isinstance(content, dict):
        return content.get(&#34;text&#34;) or json.dumps(content)[:500]
    return str(content)[:500]

for rel in parents:
    path = os.path.join(transcripts_dir, rel)
    size = os.path.getsize(path)
    if size &lt;= 200:
        print(f&#34;\n===== SKIP STUB {rel} size={size} =====&#34;)
        continue
    print(f&#34;\n{&#39;=&#39;*80}&#34;)
    print(f&#34;FILE {rel} size={size}&#34;)
    print(&#39;=&#39;*80)
    user_n = 0
    with open(path) as f:
        for i, line in enumerate(f):
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            try:
                obj = json.loads(line)
            except Exception:
                continue
            role = obj.get(&#34;role&#34;) or obj.get(&#34;type&#34;) or &#34;&#34;
            # various formats
            msg = obj.get(&#34;message&#34;) or obj
            mrole = &#34;&#34;
            if isinstance(msg, dict):
                mrole = msg.get(&#34;role&#34;) or &#34;&#34;
                content = msg.get(&#34;content&#34;)
            else:
                content = obj.get(&#34;content&#34;)
            is_user = role in (&#34;user&#34;, &#34;human&#34;) or mrole in (&#34;user&#34;, &#34;human&#34;) or obj.get(&#34;type&#34;) in (&#34;user&#34;, &#34;human&#34;)
            # cursor format often has type: user
            if not is_user:
                # check nested
                if obj.get(&#34;type&#34;) == &#34;user&#34;:
                    is_user = True
            if not is_user:
                continue
            text = extract_text(content) if content else extract_text(obj)
            # skip huge system dumps
            if not text or len(text) &lt; 8:
                continue
            # skip if it&#39;s mostly system reminder
            if &#34;agent_transcripts&#34; in text[:200] and &#34;user_query&#34; not in text:
                continue
            # extract user_query if present
            m = re.search(r&#34;&lt;user_query&gt;\s*(.*?)\s*&lt;/user_query&gt;&#34;, text, re.S)
            if m:
                q = m.group(1).strip()
            else:
                # skip system-heavy
                if &#34;&lt;system_reminder&gt;&#34; in text and &#34;&lt;user_query&gt;&#34; not in text:
                    continue
                q = text.strip()
            # truncate
            q = re.sub(r&#34;\s+&#34;, &#34; &#34;, q)
            if len(q) &gt; 800:
                q = q[:800] + &#34;…&#34;
            user_n += 1
            print(f&#34;\n--- USER #{user_n} ---&#34;)
            print(q)
    if user_n == 0:
        print(&#34;(no user messages extracted)&#34;)

def extract_text(content):
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        parts = []
        for item in content:
            if isinstance(item, str):
                parts.append(item)
            elif isinstance(item, dict):
                if item.get("type") == "text":
                    parts.append(item.get("text", ""))
                elif "text" in item:
                    parts.append(str(item["text"]))
        return "\n".join(parts)
    if isinstance(content, dict):
        return content.get("text") or json.dumps(content)[:500]
    return str(content)[:500]

for rel in parents:
    path = os.path.join(transcripts_dir, rel)
    size = os.path.getsize(path)
    if size <= 200:
        print(f"\n===== SKIP STUB {rel} size={size} =====")
        continue
    print(f"\n{'='*80}")
    print(f"FILE {rel} size={size}")
    print('='*80)
    user_n = 0
    with open(path) as f:
        for i, line in enumerate(f):
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            try:
                obj = json.loads(line)
            except Exception:
                continue
            role = obj.get("role") or obj.get("type") or ""
            # various formats
            msg = obj.get("message") or obj
            mrole = ""
            if isinstance(msg, dict):
                mrole = msg.get("role") or ""
                content = msg.get("content")
            else:
                content = obj.get("content")
            is_user = role in ("user", "human") or mrole in ("user", "human") or obj.get("type") in ("user", "human")
            # cursor format often has type: user
            if not is_user:
                # check nested
                if obj.get("type") == "user":
                    is_user = True
            if not is_user:
                continue
            text = extract_text(content) if content else extract_text(obj)
            # skip huge system dumps
            if not text or len(text) < 8:
                continue
            # skip if it's mostly system reminder
            if "agent_transcripts" in text[:200] and "user_query" not in text:
                continue
            # extract user_query if present
            m = re.search(r"<user_query>\s*(.*?)\s*</user_query>", text, re.S)
            if m:
                q = m.group(1).strip()
            else:
                # skip system-heavy
                if "<system_reminder>" in text and "<user_query>" not in text:
                    continue
                q = text.strip()
            # truncate
            q = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", q)
            if len(q) > 800:
                q = q[:800] + "…"
            user_n += 1
            print(f"\n--- USER #{user_n} ---")
            print(q)
    if user_n == 0:
        print("(no user messages extracted)")

import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone

transcripts_dir = "/Users/liamellis/.cursor/projects/Users-liamellis-Desktop-apps-ultraterrestrial-resurrection/agent-transcripts"
index_path = "/Users/liamellis/Desktop/apps/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/.cursor/hooks/state/continual-learning-index.json"

transcripts = {}
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(transcripts_dir):
    for name in files:
        if name.endswith(".jsonl"):
            path = os.path.join(root, name)
            st = os.stat(path)
            mtime_ms = int(st.st_mtime * 1000)
            transcripts[path] = {
                "mtimeMs": mtime_ms,
                "mtimeSec": int(st.st_mtime),
                "size": st.st_size,
            }

index = {
    "version": 1,
    "updatedAt": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "transcripts": dict(sorted(transcripts.items())),
}

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(index_path), exist_ok=True)
with open(index_path, "w") as f:
    json.dump(index, f, indent=2)
    f.write("\n")

print(f"indexed={len(transcripts)}")
print(f"updatedAt={index['updatedAt']}")
